name: afriwidget
description: AfriWidget static site server with AI function proxy

scripts.lint: node --check server.js academic-tools.js universal-ai.js share-results.js footer.js
scripts.build: node generate-og-assets.js && node build-prerender.js && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./input.css -o ./dist/styles.css --minify && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.copyFileSync('./dist/styles.css', './styles.css'))"
